title: Thirsty - Thirst System
description: Adds a simple Thirst System to Minecraft!
body:
## Features

### New Thirst Bar

Restore your **Thirst** by: 
*   Consuming drinkable items
*   Right-clicking a Water **Source Block**

At **6 Thirst or less** (3 Water Droplets): **Players cant sprint**
 
At **0 Thirst**: **Players slowly take damage** (just like vanilla hunger starvation)

### Config

Add any **Vanilla** or **Modded Consumable** to the Config and customize how much Thirst each item restores.

### New Items

**Bowl of Water**

*   Right-click with a vanilla Bowl on a Water Source to obtain
*   Can be consumed to restore Thirst

**Bowl of Pure Water**

*   Cook a Bowl of Water on a Campfire to obtain
*   Can be consumed to restore Thirst

**Water Canteen**

*   Right-click a Water Source to fill
*   Stores Water with 12 uses (configurable)
*   Can hold Dirty or Purified Water
*   Craft with Leather and String in a Crafting Table

### Dirty Water System

Drinking directly from a Water Source Block:
*   Applies the Thirst effect
*   Has a 10% chance to apply Poison effect (configurable)

Drinking from:
*   Bowl of Water
*   Water Bottle or
*   Dirty Water Canteen
*   Has a 30% chance to apply the Thirst effect (configurable)


### Purification

*   Cook a Water Canteen or a Bowl of Water on a Campfire to Purify the Water inside
*   **Purified Water does not apply the Thirst Effect!**

## Compatibility

*   [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) by [squeek502](https://modrinth.com/user/squeek502)

## Future Plans

*   More water purification methods
*   Per biome Thirst scaling (faster thirst depletion in Deserts and Nether biomes) 
*   More Water Canteen variants

## FAQ

> **Q: Will you add support for other Minecraft versions and modloaders?**
> 
> A: If there's enough demand in my Discord, I'll port the mod to other versions and modloaders.
